title: Calibration Conductor: epoched sweep scheduling, artifact lifecycle, and authorization
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: design and implement a Calibration Conductor in Redwood Console that manages multi-epoch quantization sweeps (FP8/INT8), enforces artifact lifecycle policies, and integrates console-level authorization and auditability.

Scope and acceptance criteria:
- Sweep orchestration: support epoched sweep definitions (e.g., warmup epochs, calibration epochs, validation epochs), configurable per-campaign. Sweeps must be restartable and resumable on executor failures.
- Artifact lifecycle: captured artifacts (activation histograms, scale factors, quant profiles, KV snapshots) must be stored with provenance metadata, signed, and tagged with TTL policies (hot/nearline/archive). Console must expose artifact browse/download with tenancy-aware ACLs.
- Authorization & audit: integrate RBAC groups + project-level ACLs so only entitled users can trigger promotion, export or permanent deletion. All actions record immutably in audit logs and link to runs.
- Validation & gating: wire a validation harness that runs an accuracy regression test per sweep epoch. If accuracy delta exceeds threshold, conductor automatically gates promotion and opens a remediation run with diff report.
- Cost and capacity controls: expose executor concurrency limits, per-run cost estimate, and autoscaling knobs for calibration workers.
- UX: Console run list must show run state, epoch progress bar, artifact retention tier, validation verdict, and quick links to signed artifact blob.

Non-goals: build the low-level executor (ENG) — this ticket focuses on orchestration, metadata, and console integrations.

Deliverables:
- Conductor API design (REST + event hooks) for scheduling, resume, promote, rollback.
- Artifact metadata schema and signed artifact format spec.
- Console UX screens & permission flows.
- Validation harness integration spec and sample baseline dataset.
- End-to-end demo: start sweep -> fail validation -> show gated rollback and remediation workflow.

2025-02-28 — Security review prelim: security team asked for signed artifact spec + KMS integration note. PM to add security_review_required. Confluence RFC started: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CAL/Conductor+Artifact+Spec

2025-03-01 — Validation harness design: proposed flow runs three validation shards with baseline comparison; if any shard delta > 0.5% absolute BLEU/EM then gate. Need product decision on default threshold and whether metric is configurable per-run.

2025-03-03 — Implementation update: basic API endpoints created: /runs, /runs/{id}/epochs, /runs/{id}/artifacts. Still missing: ACL checks on /promote and TTL enforcement in storage layer. ENG assigned follow-ups: ENG-4237 (ACL enforcement) and ENG-4238 (artifact TTL lifecycle worker).

2025-03-04 — Next steps: 1) finalize default validation thresholds (PM decision), 2) finalize artifact metadata schema and signing algorithm, 3) add telemetry events for run start/complete/validation-fail for observability dashboarding.
